title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
abstract: arXiv:2610.00025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $\tau$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $\tau$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). translated_title: 测量微任务合格性差距：现成小语言模型何时足以胜任智能体框架？
translated_abstract: 智能体框架（Agent Harness）越来越希望在作为前沿大语言模型（LLM）规划器的外围微任务上运行小语言模型（SLM）：例如自动批准 shell 命令、写入记忆、选择工具、对过往对话轮次进行排序等。我们探究现成的 SLM 是否满足从业者定义的阈值，当它们不达标时原因何在，以及量化（quantization）是否会改变结论。我们构建了一个包含 4 个此类微任务的基准测试，采用固定提示词和自动评估指标，每个任务都设有预先指定的阈值 τ，该阈值锚定于廉价的非 LLM 基线，并采用置信区间感知的合格性规则（只有当配置的置信下界超过 τ 时才判定为通过）。在最佳条件下（FP16、贪心解码、单一冻结提示词、无任何调优）对 Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B 进行扫描后，我们发现存在“合格性差距”：16 个（4 任务 × 4 模型）配置中无一通过（通过检查原始输出和解析器行为加以验证）。基于 logprob 的决策阈值诊断显示（T1/T3/T4；T2 通过上下文长度/级联方式……）
tldr: 本文构建了涵盖四个智能体微任务的基准测试，发现现成的 Qwen3 小语言模型（0.6B–8B、FP16、无需调优）在 16 个配置中无一达到从业者定义的合格阈值，揭示了“微任务合格性差距”现象。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark of four agent-harness microtasks and finds that none of sixteen off-the-shelf Qwen3 SLM configurations (0.6B–8B, FP16, no tuning) meets practitioner-defined eligibility thresholds, revealing a "microtask eligibility gap."
